-82.41050,34.81750.name: Fertility Center of the Carolinas, University Medical Group, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology
-82.41050,34.81750.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Creighton E. Likes, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-66.89900,10.50981.name: Embrios
-66.89900,10.50981.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-71.10400,42.36563.name: Eisai, Inc., Center for Genetics Guided Dementia Discovery
-71.10400,42.36563.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of a subsidiary of Eisai Co.. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

0.17906,51.56865.name: Fertility Unit Barking, Havering and Redbridge Hospitals Trust
0.17906,51.56865.state: Redbridge Hospital Trust Queen's Hospital, Rom Valley Way, Romford, Essex, RM7 0AG
0.17906,51.56865.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to King’s Fertility. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

16.61177,50.05970.name: Department for Biological Defence, Military Institute of Health
16.61177,50.05970.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Military Institute of Health. It is categorised as a defense laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 50 SqM. Operational or announced: 2007. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

13.58199,-1.61620.name: Emerging Viral Diseases Unit (L’Unité des Maladies Virales Emergentes) (UMVE)
13.58199,-1.61620.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Ministry of the Arm Forces. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in glove box. Operational or announced: 2008. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

14.15200,42.36300.name: Syngenta — biologicals and Valagro
14.15200,42.36300.desc: Syngenta’s acquisition of a biologicals company, part of every major buying into microbial and biostimulant products. The category that requires the least regulatory review is the one they are all expanding into.

11.52000,3.87000.name: Institut de Recherche Agricole pour le Développement
11.52000,3.87000.desc: Cameroon's agricultural research institute, holding germplasm and running breeding for crops grown across central Africa. Institutes of this kind hold collections nobody else has, are chronically underfunded, and are the entities that benefit-sharing arrangements are written about — usually without their participation in the writing.

-0.47700,51.49300.name: GSK — vaccines
-0.47700,51.49300.desc: Produces vaccines using recombinant antigens grown in engineered yeast and cell lines, at doses counted in the hundreds of millions a year. Recombinant hepatitis B vaccine, licensed in 1986, was among the first engineered products given to healthy people, and it set the precedent that this technology is acceptable when the alternative is a disease.
